data.name: Ayesha
data.gender_notes: Ayesha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayesha means 'alive' and 'well', a name that symbolizes a long and healthy life. It is also the name of the wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Ayesha carries the meaning “Alive and Well” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayesha usually hope their child will grow to embody alive and well and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ayesha holds a significant place in Islamic history as the youngest wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), known for her wisdom, courage, and strong faith.
data.etymology: Ayesha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alive and Well.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayesha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عائشة
in_arabic.meaning: المرأة الصالحة والراجحة واسمها مشتق من الحكمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عائشة هي كلمة عربية مشتقة من الحكمة، حيث يرتبط اسم عائشة بالفعل العائش يعني الحكيم والمثقف، وقد اختارها الرسول محمد صل الله عليه وسلم لابنته الصغيرة، كما كانت أمه الراشدة زينب بنت خزيمة، وقد أصبحت عائشة واحدة من السيدات العشرة المحظيات في الإسلام، وقد لها أهمية كبيرة في التفسير القرآني والأحاديث النبوية، وتعتبر من الشخصيات الإسلامية المهمة في تاريخ الإسلام، وقد استخدمت اسم عائشة في العديد من الأسماء في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: عائشہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک صالحہ و راجہ خاتون کا نام جو ہک حاذق اور خوش اخلاق خاتون کے لئے مخصوص ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عائشہ ایک عربي نام ہے جو حكمت اور صلاحیت کے معنی میں آتا ہے۔ اس نام کا تعلق عربي زبان سے ہے، جس کا معنی ہے حکمت والی۔ اس نام کو صحابیہ عائشہ صدیقہ کے نام پر رکھا گیا جو صحابیہ میں سے ایک تھیں۔ اس نام کو اپنی شاندار شخصیات اور شاندار کردار کی وجہ سے مسلمانوں نے اپنی بیٹیوں اور بیٹیوں کے لئے پسند کیا۔

in_hindi.name: ऐशा
in_hindi.meaning: एक अनुशासनमय और ज्ञानी स्त्री का नाम जो प्रबुद्ध और ज्ञानी है
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऐशा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ज्ञानी और अनुशासनमय। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है और यह शब्द अरबी भाषा में 'ऐशा' का अर्थ 'ज्ञानी' है। इस नाम को मुहम्मद साहब ने अपनी बेटी का नाम रखने के लिए चुना था।

in_pashto.name: عائشه
in_pashto.meaning: د پوهیدای او د ځانګړي له پوهی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عائشه د یو عربي نوم دی چې د پوهیدای او د ځانګړي له پوهي څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم عربي ژبه کې د پوهیدای او د ځانګړي له پوهي څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د یو پوهیدای او ځانګړي له پوهي څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په افغانستان کې د یو ښځي لپاره ځانګړی نوم دی.

in_english.name: Ayesha
in_english.meaning: a virtuous and wise woman, whose name is derived from wisdom and knowledge
in_english.long_meaning: Ayesha is an Arabic name that means virtuous and wise woman. The name is derived from the root word 'aisha', which means wise and knowledgeable. The Prophet Muhammad chose this name for his daughter, and it has since become a popular name among Muslims. Ayesha is considered one of the most significant women in Islamic history, and her name is often associated with wisdom, knowledge, and virtue. In Islamic tradition, Ayesha is revered as a symbol of female excellence and a role model for Muslim women.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ayesha has cultural significance in the Islamic world as it is the name of one of the most revered women in Islam. Ayesha (ra), also known as Sayyidah Ayesha (Mother of the Believers), was an important companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and is highly regarded for her knowledge, wisdom, and courage. Her story is recorded in various hadiths and sira (biography of the Prophet), making her an enduring figure in Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: Ayesha's name carries immense spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the gift of life. Both Ayesha and her namesake Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) are celebrated for their devotion to Allah and their role in spreading the message of Islam. Ayesha's life story is an inspiration for Muslims as she overcame challenges and contributed to the establishment of the Islamic community, demonstrating the importance of faith and resilience. The name Ayesha thus serves as a constant reminder of the importance of living a virtuous life and remaining steadfast in faith.
